decision: Admit stacks/nuxt-ui.csv L57 ('Use UInputDate for date selection') as SPLIT under the owner-approved D57 deferred-sibling dedup amendment (2026-11-10): the 'Use range when needed' fragment becomes its own VPInstruction/v1.2 singleton; the two L71-covered fragments are bound by exact code-point subspan to the L71-derived instruction uupm-nuxt-ui-use-uapp-locale-prop-for-internationalization-pass-locale-to-uapp (claim-equivalence, Touch-Target precedent ux-guidelines.csv L23 -> uupm-ux-target-size-minimum). The Applies To cell ('nuxt-ui 4.11.1', col 10, metadata-applicability) is covered whole-cell by the new unit's own applicability (conditions_applies_when); corpus bindings are restricted to normative-* cells per D56 §6.1, so its coverage is recorded in the coverage table rather than as a binding cell.
